chunking.bodyDocument: How this document is split into chunks the next time it is parsed.
chunking.bodyDataset: Applied to documents uploaded from now on. Documents already in this dataset keep their own settings.

method.help: Choose an available method for the next parse.

general.title: General
general.body: Splits text into chunks of a set size, ending at the delimiters you choose. Works for most documents.

qa.title: Q&A
qa.body: Keeps each question with its answer from TXT, CSV, JSON or XLSX.

paper.title: Paper
paper.body: Follows the sections of an academic paper.

book.title: Book
book.body: EPUB books and heading-based documents; preserves chapter order and ancestry.

laws.title: Laws
laws.body: Follows the article structure of legal texts.

manual.title: Manual
manual.body: Follows the heading structure of technical manuals.

tag.title: Tag
tag.body: Adds weighted tags from frequent source terms.

one.title: One document
one.body: Keeps all selected content in one chunk. Documents exceeding the embedding context are refused.

chunking.storedUnavailable: This document is set to {{method}}, which isn't available yet. Choose General to parse it.
chunking.parsedNote_one: This document was parsed with its previous settings. Its {{count}} chunk stays as it is until you parse it again.
chunking.parsedNote_other: This document was parsed with its previous settings. Its {{count}} chunks stay as they are until you parse it again.

field.sizeHelp: The largest size of one chunk. The default is 512.
field.delimitersHelp: A chunk ends early at any of these characters. Write \n for a line break.
field.overlapHelp: How much of the end of one chunk is repeated at the start of the next.
field.pagesHelp: Leave blank for all pages, or enter inclusive ranges such as 2-4, 13-30. Other file types ignore this setting.
field.layoutHelp: Detect headings, tables and figures, follow columns, and remove page headers and footers.

layout.title: Layout recognition
layout.body: Detects titles, tables and figures on each page before chunking.

keywords.title: Auto-keywords
keywords.body: Adds keywords to each chunk with a chat model.

chunking.oneSettings: Chunk size, delimiters and overlap do not split One document. PDF page selection and layout still apply.
chunking.qaSettings: Each question and answer stays in one chunk. Use Question and Answer columns, or Question:/Answer: text pairs. Split settings do not divide a pair.
chunking.bookSettings: Follows EPUB spine order and chapter headings. Large sections split within their parent chapter; chunk size applies. Delimiters and overlap do not apply.
chunking.paperSettings: Follows Abstract, Introduction, Methods and References, plus numbered sections. Chunk size applies within each section; delimiters and overlap do not apply.
chunking.lawsSettings: Follows chapters, sections, articles and items. Chunk size applies within each article; delimiters and overlap do not apply. Original source characters are preserved.
chunking.presentationSettings: Keeps each slide separate, repeating its title on long chunks. Chunk size applies within a slide; delimiters and overlap do not apply.
chunking.emailSettings: Reads the decoded From, To, Subject and Date with the message body. Plain text is preferred over HTML alternatives. Attachments are listed as ignored and never executed. Chunk size includes the repeated envelope; delimiters and overlap do not apply.
chunking.tableSettings: Keeps each data row with its table title and column headers. Chunk size limits a whole row; oversized rows are refused instead of split. Delimiters and overlap do not apply.
chunking.pictureSettings: Choose a configured vision model to describe the image, or select OCR only to read its text. The source image stays linked to the result.
chunking.resumeSettings: Read labelled name, contact, work history, education and skills with their original source. Missing values stay absent. Enable model extraction only for unstructured résumés; it may send the résumé to your selected model. Delimiters and overlap do not apply.
chunking.resumeUseModel: Use a model for unstructured résumés
chunking.resumeModel: Résumé chat model (empty uses workspace default)

chunking.sizeRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 8192.
chunking.overlapRange: Enter a whole number from 0 to 50.
chunking.pagesRange: Enter pages from 1 to 1000000, such as 2-4, 13-30.
